alias delete.reason: Edits only a disposable gh alias config; tests single deletion, missing aliases and --all without affecting shared accounts.

alias import.reason: Imports local YAML, including stdin, duplicate handling and clobber. Inventory's --label is not implemented by gh 2.102.0; its unknown-flag diagnostic is asserted.

alias list.reason: Lists only the disposable local alias configuration, including empty and populated output.

alias set.reason: Defines and executes local aliases in an isolated config, including shell expansion, stdin and collision handling.

auth logout.reason: Logout only removes local credentials and does not revoke tokens or call GitHub. Uses an isolated multi-user hosts.yml; a secondary live login case also checks logout preserves the first real identity.

auth refresh.reason: Successful scope refresh requires human approval of an OAuth device/browser authorization; PATs cannot be expanded unattended. The registered case verifies a bounded clean unauthenticated error, not a simulated refresh.

auth setup-git.reason: Writes only an isolated global gitconfig credential helper; checks normal, selected-host, forced-host and invalid-force behavior without invoking Git or the network.

auth switch.reason: Switching only updates the active local credential. Tests isolated multi-account tokens and unknown users; a live second-identity login case independently checks the resulting API identity.

auth token.reason: Token lookup reads local configuration only; tests explicit hostname/user, active account and missing credentials without exposing provisioned tokens.

completion.reason: Generates shell completion scripts entirely locally. Checks every supported shell's script and unsupported-shell errors.

config clear-cache.reason: Clears only the isolated XDG CLI cache, verifying removal and repeatability.

config get.reason: Reads defaults, global and per-host local settings and checks an unknown key.

config list.reason: Lists default and per-host local settings, asserting that host overrides do not change global values.

config set.reason: Writes only isolated local configuration, testing global/per-host settings and an invalid protocol.
